name: cloudmeta-bof

description: A lightweight web-based tool for managing Kerberos ticket (.kirbi) files directly in your browser. Store, decode, and export base64-encoded tickets with zero server dependencies.
name: kirbi-manager

description: A lightweight, unofficial syntax linter, formatter, and version-compliance checker for Cobalt Strike Malleable C2 profiles — written in plain Python with no external dependencies.
name: c2lint

description: PowerShell script to enumerate roastable SPNs in Active Directory without requiring RSAT tools. Filters out computer accounts ($) and default SPNs (HOST/, RestrictedKrbHost/), leaving only user service accounts that are potential Kerberoast targets.
name: Get-Roastable-SPNs
